name: Holdings Table with Weight Bars
note: Compact holdings list where the two column headers are real sort buttons. Day change always carries an arrow glyph as well as colour.

name: Rebalance Drift Indicator II
note: Diverging bars around a zero axis: each sleeve's drift from policy weight extends left (under) or right (over) from the centre, with a shaded plus/minus 2pp tolerance band behind them. Sleeves outside the band flip to amber and get an out-of-band marker, and the count in the footer is derived, not hard-coded. Rebalance runs a single rAF tween that walks every drift to zero (bars and numbers together); the button becomes Undo so the motion is replayable.

name: Watchlist Rows with Live Sparklines
note: Four watchlist rows, each a focusable button with an inline SVG sparkline built from a seeded random walk so the shape is identical on every load. A slow timer (2.4s) nudges one row's last price, shifts its series, redraws the polyline and flashes the price cell green or red; the change cell keeps its arrow so the direction survives without colour. The timer never starts under prefers-reduced-motion, pauses while the tab is hidden, and self-clears if the node is detached.

The 1D / 1W toggle re-ranks each column by magnitude and tweens every percentage with a rAF count-up while the bars slide; arrows on the column headers and on every value carry the direction independently of colour.
